No one is allowed to repost this mod anywhere, please alert me if anyone does so.
[font=Arial Black][color=#93c47d][size=5][line][/size][/color][/font][font=Arial Black][color=#B45F06][size=5]What it Does[/size][/color][/font]
It simply makes coffee give you 33 energy and tripple shot espresso 100, the health also gets a buff as the values are connected.

[line][color=#B45F06]
[font=Arial Black][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/font][/color]
it should be compatible with any mod as long as it doesn't also edit the energy given by coffee and espresso, even other mods altering other parts of coffee should be fine.
[line]

[color=#FAC08F][font=Arial Black][size=5][color=#B45F06]Installation[/color]
[/size][/font][/color]place [CP]coffee gives energy folder in mods folder
[line]

[font=Arial Black][color=#B45F06][size=5]Un-instillation[/size][/color][/font]
remove [CP]coffee gives energy folder from mods the folder
[line]

[font=Arial Black][color=#B45F06][size=5]Bugs[/size][/color][/font]
the mod only applies to new coffee, coffee made before the mod is installed will keep the old stats
[line]

[font=Arial Black][color=#93c47d][size=5][color=#B45F06]Permissions[/color]
[/size][/color][/font]you can make a translation if its necessary but only upload it on nexus and give credit.
